Synopsis:
Germany is preparing to formally attribute a drone/explosive device found at Leipzig/Halle airport in August to Russia, with potential new coordinated EU/Western sanctions against Moscow to follow. The airport is a dual-use NATO logistics and civilian freight hub. Senior German officials signal a firm but measured response, framing the incident as part of Russia's broader hybrid warfare campaign against European NATO members supporting Ukraine.
